name: @sos-2/tests-production-hardening
description: SOS 2.0 Production Hardening acceptance suite (Work Order P14): the pinned acceptance tests for security, cost and reliability — no cross-project workspace access (typed denial, fail-closed); no secret leakage through artifacts/logs (redaction or denial + observed redaction); bounded execution cost (typed denial, honest ACCOUNTING_UNKNOWN); stale/expired authority fails closed (COMPOSED with the real merged P9 action gateway); body crash and provider outage recover cleanly through typed dead-letter records with bounded retry then ASK and honest UNKNOWN provider health; preview cannot mutate production (pinned isolation contract); operational diagnostics identify the responsible task/body/provider; the complete runbook exists; structural discipline (zero deps, offline determinism, fixed seed, merged + P14-owned imports only). Declares ZERO dependencies (lockfile byte-identity rule): composition with merged packages happens through test-time module aliases and the toolchain is borrowed at run time from the frozen W17 adversarial suite.
